questions.question: Who is the great prince who arises to defend Daniel's people in chapter 12?
What does Daniel 12 say about those who sleep in the dust of the earth?
options: Many shall awake, some to everlasting life and some to shame
The dead shall all remain forever and ever in the dust
All alike shall be gathered together at last to one peaceful rest
Only the kings of old shall rise again to rule once more
questions.answer: Many shall awake, some to everlasting life and some to shame

questions.question: Daniel 12 says those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the sky.
